description: The right foot rolled 20: the same turn about its toe pivot (-4, 3.3, 1.8) as the left foot's, so the offset is the left's. The toe pivot is the toe joint (4, 3.3, 1.8), so the hand at (4, 4, 0) is offset (dy 0.7, dz -1.8) from it, the toe bone's length 1.931321, and it keeps that length to the planted toe. The Limb is at IK, so its hand reaches the foot's ankle target.
